messages.subject: ggmap locator
parts:
So, the clickId property of plotOutput works with ggmap... shiny::runGist("https://gist.github.com/corynissen/17fbd9c3c2932b100349")

But, I can't figure out what coordinates it's returning, and more importantly, how to translate that into a latitude longitude. 

Any ideas?

Thanks

messages.author: 85e053d519f0f372
messages.subject: Re: ggmap locator
parts:
Sorry but it seems we forgot to document it: clickId/hoverId only
works with R base graphics. ggmap is based on grid graphics, which
will not work in this case (same thing applies to ggplot2, lattice,
...).

Regards,
Yihui

messages.subject: Re: ggmap locator
parts:
Yes, it will return a value anyway, but the value is completely wrong.
Internally clickId makes use of the information par('usr'), which only
makes sense to base graphics.

Regards,
Yihui
